subject: [PATCH v8 01/30] mm: rename pmd_to_softleaf_folio() to pmd_softleaf_to_folio()

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch renames the function pmd_to_softleaf_folio() to pmd_softleaf_to_folio() in the Linux kernel, which decodes a softleaf entry stored in a PMD and returns the folio it references. The renaming is done for clarity as the original name suggested that the function converted a PMD into a folio, whereas it actually converts a softleaf entry to a folio. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
